review_style.value: Reviews agent work personally before pushing, except Sanductor's own Swift; depth depends on the code
review_style.quote: Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol at Extra High effort, with local review and testing.

also.quote: usually some manual code review before pushing (although, perhaps ironically, not for Sanductor’s Swift itself).
I don't trust the tool, I trust the tools I write to supervise the tool.
I always review any agent-produced work as my normal user in the same shared worktree before I share it with others.
How many of these I do depends on my familiarity with the code, its criticality and how confident I am in other guardrails e.g. CI, human review.
The wildest part: I have not (deliberately) read a single line of Swift code.
open a PR, wait for CI results and code review from humans or Copilot
